title: Review of lab 1's ad9-ledger (IB) on fresh seeds 7 and 8, with the first labkit packs of this world: 9-12 bounded droplets persist, each with a self-made amphiphile rim (rim/core 4.85 and 4.89; 57/57 and 60/62 individuals)
summary: Ran threads/active-droplets/worlds/ad9-ledger/world.py unchanged with labkit (128^2, t=20000) on seeds 7 and 8. Six planted gated droplets grow on the fuel and divide by dumbbell pinches (4 and 6 persistent splits, 0 merges) up to the world's droplet cap of 12, where the coded Moran dilution erases one droplet per birth (a droplet being erased is visible at t=20000 on seed 7). Droplets are bounded (persistent-track area ratio 1.6-1.8; 10 and 12 tracks alive for >= half the run). The amphiphile psi forms a rim on every droplet: rim/core 4.85 / 4.89, rim/out 13.9 / 14.7, 57/57 and 60/62 individuals membrane-like, and it is the only membrane-like channel. psi is made by the droplets' own reaction and drifts up grad|grad phi|^2 (self-made quasi-equilibrium layer); here it also gates diffusion (ad7 lineage).

observations.I: rerun7/sheet.png: 6 -> 12 discrete bounded droplets (area ratio 1.80), 10 tracks alive for >= half the run
observations.B: rerun7/radial.png: psi rim/core 4.85, rim/out 13.9, 57/57 membrane-like; seed 8 4.89 / 14.7, 60/62

not_checked: the L7 selection part (not in this claim)
verdicts.limitation: Planted founders; deaths are a coded Moran dilution once the cap is reached; the psi layer is placed by a drift up |grad phi|^2 and is 1-2 px wide, with no resolution test or source ablation run here.
